run_visualize: run the python module to visualize evaluation predictions by drawing points on images and saving results
build_visualize_cli: build a python CLI tool that takes a meta file and save path to visualize image predictions with red points
test_visualize: test the python module visualize function by providing a meta file path and output directory for saved images
refactor_visualize: refactor the python visualize function to support configurable point colors and sizes for image annotation
review_visualize: review the python module visualize function that loads Eval_Meta predictions and draws points on images using draw_image_by_points
